description: M9 wired-only proof build with optional desktop/network integrations disabled so the executable dependency closure remains GLib + libndp + systemd + D-Bus.

commands.command:
mkdir build &&
cd build &&

meson setup ..                    \
      --prefix=/usr               \
      --buildtype=release         \
      -D libaudit=no              \
      -D nmtui=false              \
      -D wifi=false               \
      -D polkit=false             \
      -D introspection=false      \
      -D vapi=false               \
      -D tests=no                 \
      -D libpsl=false             \
      -D concheck=false           \
      -D firewalld_zone=false     \
      -D crypto=null              \
      -D ovs=false                \
      -D ppp=false                \
      -D nbft=false               \
      -D selinux=false            \
      -D qt=false                 \
      -D session_tracking=systemd \
      -D nm_cloud_setup=false     \
      -D clat=false               \
      -D modem_manager=false

for file in $(echo ../man/*.[1578]); do
    section=${file##*.} &&
    install -vdm 755 /usr/share/man/man$section
    install -vm 644 $file /usr/share/man/man$section/
done
